target: AArch64 native ZealC under UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-interactive-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps

checks.GrModels: Man form and color selection generated a 112-vertex/168-triangle mesh with 1,273 visible inline pixels; Ball generated 58 vertices with 778 visible purple pixels. Both completed their repeat prompts and returned to a working terminal; zstatus failed=0.
checks.KeepAway: Court and HUD rendered; gameplay, pointer movement and Space input updated the frame; Escape returned to terminal focus and removed the Animate task; zstatus failed=0.
checks.Titanium: Press-a-key intro advanced; Left and Right moved the player, Space advanced gameplay, and Escape returned to a working terminal; zstatus failed=0.
checks.shared_regressions: 3D mesh/interpolation/services fixtures and shared GUI terminal, compiler, task, source-context, and system-server regressions passed.
